name: Duplicate Converter
description: What a copy you already own turns into. Duplicates are the majority of a collection game's output, and a genre that treats them as nothing teaches players that pulling is mostly disappointment. Conversion is declared per rarity, so a duplicate legendary is worth meaningfully more than a duplicate common, and the shards it produces are ordinary currency that other components can spend. Conversion is automatic by default and announced, because a player who has to visit a menu to convert will one day discover a thousand unconverted copies and reasonably feel the game wasted them.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.
